title: West Uusimaa: €355,640 a year, about 2.0 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)
markdown:
# West Uusimaa: €355,640 a year, about 2.0 lung cancer deaths avoided a year (modelled)

> About 2.0 deaths avoided a year (modelled) · €355,640 of €1.00M · €644,360 left: nothing else pays off at these assumptions

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in West Uusimaa, 32 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. No stage of the care path is below the national level beyond chance. [^care_curative] There is no shortfall to close. [^model] West Uusimaa treats a larger share of patients to cure than Finland as a whole, and its share is at or above that of the best quarter of counties (30.4%). [^care_curative] [^model] This plan therefore ranks measures by deaths avoided a year instead. [^model]

## The target

This plan is ranked by deaths avoided: about 2.0 a year (range −0.2 to 5.5), for €355,640 a year. [^model] Deaths avoided are modelled from stated assumptions, not observed. [^model] The low end is below zero: how much delay adds to lung cancer deaths is not statistically certain, so no benefit cannot be ruled out. [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | Deaths avoided a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Smoking cessation started at the first specialist visit**[^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1]. Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology | €85,640 | 0.7 (0.1–1.6) | Write the standing order: every smoker with suspected lung cancer leaves the first visit with cessation medicine and a nurse call booked. | Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027 |
| 2 | **Standardised lung cancer pathway with booked slots**[^ev_cpp_pathway_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology (county pathway); FICAN and the national lung cancer group (national pathway description) | €100,000 | 0.7 (−0.3 to 2.6) | Name one pathway owner and book fixed weekly CT, PET-CT, bronchoscopy and MDT slots for suspected lung cancer. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 39.4 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| 3 | **Same-day chest X-ray report with immediate CT**[^ev_same_day_cxr_ct_1]. Chief radiologist together with the chief physician of primary care | €109,000 | 0.4 (−0.0 to 1.3) | Agree with radiology that a suspicious chest X-ray is followed by CT the same day, without a new referral. | Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027 |
| 4 | **Nurse navigator for every suspected lung cancer**[^ev_nurse_navigator_1]. Head nurses of pulmonology and oncology; director of nursing | €61,000 | 0.2 (−0.0 to 0.2) | Name one nurse who books every test for each new suspected lung cancer patient and calls the patient with the dates. | Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 39.4 days → 36.9 days by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€355,640** | **2.0 (−0.2 to 5.5)** | | |

Effects are modelled from published studies and stated assumptions, not observed here. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €1.54M a year; modelled to avoid 2.7 deaths a year (0.6–7.0). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of smoking patients given cessation medicine at the first visit: not published today → 90% by 2027. [^model]
- Days from diagnosis to start of treatment (median): 39.4 days → 36.9 days by 2028. [^care_time_to_treatment][^model]
- Days from suspicious chest X-ray to CT: not published today → 3 days by 2027. [^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

EUR 355,640 a year already buys every measure that the model expects to avoid deaths in West Uusimaa. [^model] The remaining EUR 644,360 buys nothing more in the model, since the other measures add nothing or cost too much per death avoided. [^model] Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers needs a national decision. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 171 deaths a year in West Uusimaa, and this plan is modelled to avoid 2.0 of them (range -0.16 to 5.5). [^deaths] [^model]

## Limits

- Effect ranges are not probabilities. They run from every assumption at its lowest to every assumption at its highest, and no trial has measured these effects. [^model]
- County shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, histology, smoking or recording, and county figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- Only 0 of 3 outcomes matched the estimated symptom-to-treatment clock beyond chance. [^model]
